answer: Endorsement bonds with a slashing cascade: a new identity joins only when two established agents vouch for it, each locking a bond slashed if the newcomer is proven a clone. A sparrow of one honest agent finds two sponsors once and is done, but a farm minting a thousand clones must burn its sponsors' bonds a thousand times or buy fresh sponsors at market price. The prism of the audit splits every clone's history into its sponsors, so one caught identity collapses a whole farm, while the oasis of honest work stays open: one good record earns sponsors their bonds back with interest.
